description: Stage 9.6D pilot — OG-02 Household Risk Identifier as a market-neutral core resource plus the safety blocks it requires. The teaching content stays in the re-skinned HTML document; this file carries the library record and the safety layer.

resource.title: Household Risk Identifier
resource.description: Identify the top risks your household faces, then rank them by probability and impact so you know what to tackle first.
resource.body: Rate each household risk for probability and impact, multiply the two, and work on the highest scores first. If you are unsure where to start, your {{agency.emergencyManagement}} publishes guidance for your area.

general-disclaimer.title: Before you start
general-disclaimer.body: OffGrid056 gives general household resilience education, not professional advice. Anything involving fixed wiring, gas, structural work or an appliance flue must be done by a suitably qualified and licensed tradesperson in your area — in {{market.name}}, that means a {{term.electrician}} or {{term.gasfitter}}. Where this material names a standard, agency or programme, check it still applies to you before relying on it.

emergency-contact.title: In an emergency
emergency-contact.body: **In an emergency, call {{emergency.number}} now.** If you are unsure whether it is an emergency, call anyway and ask — the operator will help you decide. Guidance for your area: {{agency.emergencyManagement}}.

marketBody.NZ: **In an emergency, call {{emergency.number}} now.** Calls are free and work on a mobile even with no credit. If you are unsure whether it is an emergency, call anyway and ask — the operator will help you decide. {{emergency.accessibility}}. Guidance for your area: {{agency.emergencyManagement}}.
marketBody.AU: **In an emergency, call {{emergency.number}} now.** You can also dial 112 from a mobile, which reaches the same service. If you are unsure whether it is an emergency, call anyway and ask — the operator will help you decide. {{emergency.accessibility}}. Guidance for your area: {{agency.emergencyManagement}}.
